name: Bachelor of Medical Science
Graduate Diploma of Clinical Physiology
curriculum:
Structure — Complete 80 credit points comprising: 80 credit points for all Core Courses;
Core Courses (Complete 80 credit points for ALL of the following) — Professional Issues: Research methodology, legal and ethical issues (7207NSC); Pathophysiology of Major Organ Systems (7213NSC); Evaluation of Organ Function by Physical Means (7215NSC); Principles of Biomedical Instrumentation (7218NSC); Physiology Clinical Placement A (7208NSC); Physiology Clinical Placement B (7211NSC)

name: Graduate Certificate in International Relations
curriculum:
Structure — Complete 40 credit points comprising: 40 credit points for all Foundation Module;
Foundation Module (Complete 40 credit points for ALL of the following) — International Relations: Ideas and Issues (7001GIR); Diplomacy and Foreign Policy (3028GIR); Environment and Development (7461ENV); Government-Business Relations in Global Context (7002GIR)

name: Master of Science
curriculum:
Structure — Complete 160 credit points comprising: 160 credit points for one Major from Research Majors;
Applied Mathematics: Coursework Courses (Complete 40 credit points for ALL of the following) — Topics in Applied Mathematics 1 (6205NSC); Topics in Applied Mathematics 2 (6206NSC); Topics in Applied Mathematics 3 (6207NSC); Topics in Applied Mathematics 4 (6208NSC)
Physics: Coursework Courses (Complete 40 credit points for ALL of the following) — Tensors, Groups and General Relativity (6005ESC); Honours Classical and Quantum Mechanics (6006ESC); Classical and Quantum Electrodynamics (6007ESC); Honours Statistical and Condensed Matter Physics (6304NSC)
All other majors: Coursework Courses (Complete 40 credit points for ALL of the following) — Research Design and Methods (7161ESC); Scientific Data Analysis (6003ESC); Strategies for Effective Science Communication (8000ESC); Exploring the Literature (7181ESC)
All majors: Dissertation Courses (Complete 120 credit points for ALL of the following) — Dissertation (8002ESC_P1); Dissertation (8002ESC_P2); Dissertation (8002ESC_P3); Dissertation (8002ESC_P4); Dissertation (8002ESC_P5); Dissertation (8002ESC_P6)

name: Master of Biotechnology
curriculum:
Structure — Complete 160 credit points for one of the following pathways: Pathway 1, 1 year (80 credit points of study and 80 for prior learning); Pathway 2, 1.5 years (120 credit points of study and 40 for prior learning); Pathway 3, 2 years (160 credit points of study);
Courses (Complete 80 credit points for ALL of the following) — Molecular Advanced Biotechnology (7100ESC); Advanced Protein Engineering (7101ESC); Advanced Applied Bioinformatics (7104ESC); Commercialising and Launching Innovative Ventures (7126IBA); Research Design and Methods (7161ESC); Strategies for Effective Science Communication (8000ESC); Law and Synthetic Biology (5338LAW); Entrepreneurial Leadership (7127IBA)

name: Master of Catchment Science
curriculum:
Structure — Complete 160 credit points for one of the following pathways: Pathway 1, 1 year (80 credit points of study and 80 for prior learning); Pathway 2, 1.5 years (120 credit points of study and 40 for prior learning); Pathway 3, 2 years (160 credit points of study);
Courses (Complete 80 credit points for ALL of the following) — Catchment Ecology (7001ESC); Data and Computing Skills for Catchment Science (7003ESC); Environmental And Water Economics (7401ENV); Soils and Geomorphology in Catchment Science (7304ESC); River and Catchment Management and Rehabilitation (7302ESC); Catchment Measurement and Monitoring (7303ESC); Hydrologic and Hydraulic Modelling (7415ENG); Environmental Pollution (7421ENV)

name: Master of Health and Medical Research
curriculum:
Structure — Complete 120 credit points comprising: 20 credit points for all Core Courses, and 20 credit points from Listed Electives, and 80 credit points for all Research Thesis Courses;
Core Courses (Complete 20 credit points for ALL of the following) — Dissertation Preparation (7010HLS), to be completed in the first trimester of enrolment; One of Quantitative Research (7011HLS), Qualitative Research (7018NRS) or Applied Research Statistics and Meta-Analysis (7009MED)
Listed Electives (Complete exactly 20 credit points from the following) — Advanced Studies in Health Sciences (6001MSC); Advanced Studies in Exercise Science (6002AHS); Topics in Drug Discovery (6195NSC); Applied Research Statistics and Meta-Analysis (7009MED); Quantitative Research (7011HLS); Qualitative Research (7018NRS); Clinical Trials - Principles and Practice (7035PHM); Epidemiology: Principles and Practices (7312MED)
Research Thesis Courses (Complete 80 credit points for ALL of the following) — Research Thesis, parts 1 to 8 (8901HLS_P1 to 8901HLS_P8)

name: Graduate Diploma of Research Studies in Business
curriculum:
Structure — Complete 80 credit points for either of the following pathways: Pathway 1, 0.5 year (40 credit points of study and 40 for prior learning); Pathway 2, 1 year (80 credit points of study);
Courses (Complete 40 credit points for ALL of the following) — GBS Dissertation, parts 1 to 4 (8001GBS_P1 to 8001GBS_P4)
